# VoxelRust base content.  (Generated by tools/gen_base.py; hand edits are fine too.)
#
# Everything in the game world is declared here: textures, blocks and items.
# This file is built into the game; a pack file (see docs/DATA.md) is read
# after it and may add to it or redefine anything by reusing its id.
#
#   texture <id> builtin <painter>            a built-in procedural texture
#   texture <id> paint <style> <r> <g> <b>    a built-in pattern in any colour
#   texture <id> flat <r> <g> <b> [noise n]   a plain colour with some grain
#   texture <id> file <image.tga>             a 16x16 TGA next to the pack file
#
#   block <id>
#     name <display name>
#     shape cube | cutout | translucent | cross | liquid | slab | stairs | fence | wall
#     box x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1                   custom shape, in 1/16ths of a block
#     tex <all>   or   tex <top> <side> <bottom>
#     light <0..15>      skyloss <0..15>      solid yes|no
#     hardness <seconds> drops <item>|nothing category <tab name>
#     rotate             four facings, placed facing the player
#     flip               also upside-down, placed by where you aim
#     unbreakable        hidden (no item)
#
#   item <id>
#     name <display name>     icon <texture>      category <tab name>
#     place <block>           brush <radius>      reach <blocks>     stack <n>

# ---- Stairs, slabs, walls and fences ----
# `shape stairs` is two boxes plus `rotate` and `flip`; `shape slab` is one box
# plus `flip`. `shape wall` and `shape fence` join up with their neighbours.

# ---- Crafting tiers ----
# `use craft` is the crafting table's 3 x 3 grid; `use craft 5` a crafting
# bench's 5 x 5 and `use craft 7` a workshop's 7 x 7. A recipe needs the
# smallest grid its pattern fits in (nothing is written for that), and a
# bigger bench makes everything a smaller one does. The bench is made from a
# crafting table and the workshop from a bench.
texture bench5_top paint bench5 150 156 166
texture bench5_side paint bench_side 150 156 166
texture bench7_top paint bench7 100 118 150
texture bench7_side paint bench_side 100 118 150
block crafting_bench
  name Crafting Bench
  tex bench5_top bench5_side bench5_side
  category Shapes
  hardness 2.0
  tool pick
  use craft 5
block workshop
  name Workshop
  tex bench7_top bench7_side bench7_side
  category Shapes
  hardness 2.4
  tool pick
  use craft 7
shaped crafting_bench 1 "III" "ITI" "PPP" with I iron_ingot T crafting_table P @planks
shaped workshop 1 "IIIII" "IPPPI" "IPBPI" "IPPPI" "IIIII" with I iron_ingot P @planks B crafting_bench
block big_chest
  name Big Chest
  tex oak_chest
  category Storage
  hardness 1.6
  use chest
  box 0 0 0 16 15 16
  tool axe
shaped big_chest 1 "PPPPP" "P...P" "P.C.P" "P...P" "PPPPP" with P @planks C oak_chest
block prop_part

# ---- Recipes (survival mode) ----
# Recipes are laid out in the crafting grid (2 x 2 in the inventory screen,
# 3 x 3 at a crafting table, 5 x 5 at a bench, 7 x 7 at a workshop):
#   craft  <item> <count> <ingredient> <count> [<ingredient> <count> ...]    shapeless
#   shaped <item> <count> <row> [<row> ...] with <letter> <ingredient> [<letter> <ingredient> ...]
#   group  <name> <item> [<item> ...]       @name in a recipe means any of them
# This file writes plain `craft` lines; tools/craft_convert.py turns the ones
# with a well-known shape (tools, stairs, doors, beds ...) into `shaped` ones.
group planks planks pine_planks
craft planks 4 log 1
craft pine_planks 4 pine_log 1
shaped stick 4 "M" "M" with M @planks
shaped crafting_table 1 "MM" "MM" with M @planks
shaped wood_pick 1 "III" ".S." ".S." with I @planks S stick
shaped stone_stairs 4 "M.." "MM." "MMM" with M stone
shaped stone_slab 6 "MMM" with M stone
shaped cobble_stairs 4 "M.." "MM." "MMM" with M cobble
shaped cobble_slab 6 "MMM" with M cobble
shaped planks_stairs 4 "M.." "MM." "MMM" with M planks
shaped planks_slab 6 "MMM" with M planks
shaped planks_fence 3 "MSM" "MSM" with M planks S stick
shaped wood_axe 1 "II" "IS" ".S" with I @planks S stick
shaped wood_shovel 1 "I" "S" "S" with I @planks S stick
shaped stone_pick 1 "III" ".S." ".S." with I cobble S stick
shaped stone_axe 1 "II" "IS" ".S" with I cobble S stick
shaped stone_shovel 1 "I" "S" "S" with I cobble S stick
shaped iron_pick 1 "III" ".S." ".S." with I iron_ore S stick
shaped iron_axe 1 "II" "IS" ".S" with I iron_ore S stick
shaped iron_shovel 1 "I" "S" "S" with I iron_ore S stick
shaped oak_chest 1 "MMM" "M.M" "MMM" with M planks
craft cooked_meat 1 raw_meat 1 coal 1
craft cooked_fish 1 raw_fish 1 coal 1
craft stone 1 cobble 1 coal 1
shaped stone_bricks 4 "MM" "MM" with M stone
craft glass 2 sand 2 coal 1
craft brick 2 clay 2 coal 1
shaped sandstone 1 "MM" "MM" with M sand
craft lamp 1 glass 1 crystal 1

# ---- Models and creatures ----
#   model <id> builtin <name>            a model shipped with the game
#   model <id> file <model.bbmodel>      a Blockbench model next to the data file
#
#   entity <id>
#     name <display name>      model <model id>      tint <r> <g> <b>
#     height <blocks>          width <blocks>        speed <blocks per second>
#     health <points>          damage <points>       weight <spawn chance>
#     behavior wander | npc | hostile | swim
#     biomes <names...>        night (appears only after dark)
#     drops <item> <count>     what it leaves when killed in survival
model player builtin player
model player_slim builtin player_slim
model grazer builtin grazer
texture string paint web 236 236 240
item string
  name String
  icon string
  category Materials

# ---- Sounds ----
# Every sound is made on the spot from a burst of noise and a gliding tone.
#   sound <id> <effects|steps|ui> <seconds> <noise 0..1> <hz from> <hz to> <low-pass 0..1> <loudness> [caption]
# The caption is what subtitles show. Redefine an id to retune a sound; give
# blocks `sound <id>` (breaking and placing) and creatures `sound <id>` (their call).
# `rain` and `wave` are only the subtitles of the rain and sea beds, which the game
# builds from grains (docs/SOUND.md); `thunder` is the subtitle and tone of its takes.
sound step steps 0.09 0.95 90 60 0.10 0.55 Footsteps
sound break effects 0.22 0.90 160 70 0.30 0.80 Block breaks
sound place effects 0.10 0.70 220 140 0.22 0.70 Block placed
sound hurt effects 0.25 0.25 420 180 0.50 0.80 Something is hurt
sound click ui 0.05 0.20 900 700 0.60 0.45
sound pop effects 0.08 0.10 500 900 0.60 0.45 Item picked up
sound splash effects 0.35 1.00 100 100 0.45 0.60 Splash
sound thunder effects 1.80 1.00 60 40 0.04 1.00 Thunder
sound rain effects 0.45 1.00 100 100 0.60 0.22 Rain
sound rumble effects 0.60 0.90 46 34 0.03 0.90 The ground rumbles
sound wave effects 1.60 1.00 80 60 0.07 0.30 Waves
sound glass effects 0.18 0.55 1800 900 0.55 0.50 Glass breaks
sound wood effects 0.14 0.75 240 150 0.25 0.75 Wood knocks
sound door effects 0.16 0.60 180 120 0.20 0.70 Door
sound bow effects 0.20 0.30 240 520 0.60 0.60 Bowstring
sound bow_draw effects 0.50 0.25 120 300 0.45 0.40 Bowstring creaks
sound bow_load effects 0.09 0.60 1400 700 0.55 0.45 Crossbow clicks
sound munch effects 0.06 0.85 320 200 0.35 0.45 Biting
sound gulp effects 0.14 0.35 200 110 0.30 0.45 Drinking
sound moo effects 0.70 0.05 150 110 0.30 0.50 Cow lows
sound baa effects 0.45 0.10 420 340 0.40 0.45 Sheep bleats
sound oink effects 0.25 0.35 260 180 0.30 0.50 Pig grunts
sound cluck effects 0.12 0.15 700 500 0.60 0.40 Hen clucks
sound bark effects 0.14 0.30 420 260 0.50 0.60 Dog barks
sound meow effects 0.40 0.05 700 520 0.60 0.40 Cat meows
sound howl effects 1.40 0.05 320 520 0.50 0.55 Wolf howls
sound growl effects 0.60 0.60 110 80 0.15 0.70 Growling
sound hiss effects 0.50 1.00 100 100 0.45 0.30 Hissing
sound chirp effects 0.10 0.02 2400 3200 0.60 0.22 Bird chirps
sound buzz effects 0.40 0.20 210 230 0.70 0.20 Buzzing
sound groan effects 0.90 0.30 120 80 0.20 0.60 Groaning
sound rattle effects 0.30 0.85 900 700 0.50 0.45 Bones rattle
sound roar effects 1.20 0.70 140 60 0.12 1.00 A roar
sound chime effects 0.60 0.02 1200 1180 0.60 0.40 Chime
sound rail effects 0.12 0.80 300 260 0.35 0.35 Cart on rails
sound whoosh effects 0.35 1.00 100 100 0.30 0.50 Whoosh
sound sizzle effects 0.50 1.00 100 100 0.45 0.22 Sizzling
sound explosion effects 1.10 1.00 90 30 0.06 1.00 Explosion
sound chest_open effects 0.30 0.40 130 320 0.45 0.55 Chest opens
sound chest_close effects 0.16 0.60 260 100 0.40 0.65 Chest closes

# ---- Dimensions ----
# Other worlds inside each world, with their own land and their own saved
# chunks: /dim NAME goes there, /dim home comes back. Packs add their own
# and may send players through with scripts (a portal block, say).
#   dimension <name> <normal|flat|void|islands>
dimension sky islands
dimension flatland flat
dimension void void
dimension mirror normal

# ---- Things that open ----
#   toggle <block>   right click swaps the block for another (and back)
#   tall             two blocks high: placed, broken and toggled together
# Describe the shape as seen when the player faces north while placing.
texture oak_door paint door 176 136 84
block oak_door
  name Oak Door
  tex oak_door
  category Doors
  hardness 1.2
  tool axe
  rotate
  box 0 0 13 16 16 16
  toggle oak_door_open
  tall
block oak_door_open
  name Oak Door
  tex oak_door
  hardness 1.2
  tool axe
  rotate
  hidden
  box 0 0 0 3 16 16
  toggle oak_door
  drops oak_door
  tall
shaped oak_door 1 "MM" "MM" "MM" with M planks

# ---- Emotes ----
#   emote <id> <name> <seconds> [loop]
#     key <time> <bone> <x> <y> <z>     degrees added to the bone's own turn, eased between keys

  key 0.0 R-Arm 0 0 0
  key 0.45 R-Arm 0 0 150
  key 1.95 R-Arm 0 0 150
  key 2.4 R-Arm 0 0 0
